scope: Synthetic metadata-service microbenchmark; not full extension validation or representative project/network evidence.

environment.storageLabel: Linux container overlay filesystem; physical storage substrate and contention unknown; no network share

methodology.baseline: One synchronous fs.existsSync per reference; no parsing, latest-version directory scans, diagnostic creation or VS Code events.
methodology.enabled: Same path checks plus sequential calls through a fresh createGeoPackageInventoryPass; inventory asserted once per distinct database.
methodology.coldMeaning: Worker inventory cache invalidated before every trial; workers remain alive. OS and storage caches are not cold.
methodology.warmMeaning: Fresh pass after untimed inventory priming; identity/header verification remains enabled.
methodology.firstWorkerRead: Separate first read includes startup of one worker; subsequent matrix runs after both slots have been warmed.
methodology.memoryCaveat: RSS includes all process threads and is sampled, not an OS peak. Off trials retain already-started idle workers; not isolated off/on memory comparisons.
methodology.descriptorCaveat: Linux /proc/self/fd snapshots outside timed work; null on other systems. Not peak native handle measurements.
methodology.heartbeat: A 2 ms timer measures additional scheduling delay; per-trial observation includes an untimed 3 ms drain. Instrumentation and shared-host scheduling affect it.
methodology.percentile: p95 uses nearest rank; median averages the two central values for even counts.

datasets.description: One empty spatial layer; repeated references to the same database.
Eight empty spatial layers in one database.
One hundred empty spatial layers in one database.
One empty spatial layer plus a registered attributes table containing a materialized 16 MiB SQLite zeroblob; no sparse-file padding.
References cycle over up to sixteen distinct single-layer databases; fewer references use fewer databases.

defaultDecision: Keep enableGeoPackageLayerChecks false; Windows, QGIS and representative network validation remain outstanding.
